title: Live Update Serving Mode
description: How a live creative serves while a seller decides an in-place change to it. Ordered from least to most disruptive: uninterrupted, staged, paused_for_review.

enumDescriptions.uninterrupted: The seller decides the change inside the sync_creatives call, for every assignment. Accepted: the item returns action updated with status approved and the changed creative serves. Refused: the item fails and the creative and its serving are unchanged. The in-call decision is the review of the change.
enumDescriptions.staged: The approved prior version keeps serving under the same creative_id while the change is reviewed as a staged update. On approval the seller promotes it on every assignment. on_rejection says what serves if review rejects it.
enumDescriptions.paused_for_review: The creative enters pending_review and does not serve until the change is approved (the ordinary revision lifecycle).
